trigger: The official same-K undistortion remap leaves a 3.77% out-of-bounds image region. R2 treated the black remap border as valid support.

change.undistortion_validity: Compute the remap-valid mask from the official calibration maps, resize it with nearest-neighbour interpolation, and exclude invalid previous/current pixels from pair support.
change.raw_arm: No numerical change. The R2 and R3 50-pair raw ledgers are byte-identical.
change.raw_full_run_reuse: raw_continuous_r2 is admitted as the R3 raw arm because the raw pilot pair ledger is byte-identical.
